notes.title: PERFORMANCE UPDATE and Controls
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

We worked overnight to solve all the problems you pointed in reviews! Hope you like it!
What we did:

PERFORMANCE:
- Change the grass amount on Quality Settings.
- Change tree amount on Quality Settings.
- Optimized grass and trees.
- Optimized Ikarus and Booster lights.
- Optimized toy entrance.
- Shadows quality distance (HUGE increase in performance)
- Optimized World Ocean.
- Optimized Sky Clouds.

CONTROLLERS:
- Flip between vertical/horizontal axis, if needed.
- invert horizontal or vertical axis, if needed.

We are still trying to improve everything and soon will add more toys (for free!) 

Thank you for all your feedback! It will always help us to improve Orlando Theme Park VR!
